scope: Battle widgets outside the core reticle. All paths, symbols and snapshots refer to stock resources. Calls document the native data contract; snapshot steps select original display states in the isolated preview. Layout identifies the original WidgetsPanel group, relative to crosshair; offsets are omitted unless proven. Empty vehicle/profile lists mean no supplementary battle widget for the existing mechanic.

auxiliary_rocket_launcher.notes: Ho-Ri Shugo rocket installation selected and ready for firing. No discrete shot feedback or artificial target is emitted.

bustle_feed.notes: BV-111 external feed active, neither switching nor disabled. Stock widget calls progress during switch transitions only; the post-shot reload timer remains in the original crosshair.

charge_shot.notes: Object 432U stock AP damage 450 × max level factor 1.244 = rounded 560. At native level 3 and 99% charge, the progress reaches the final authored frame and the 0.06 s timer displays 0.0. The top alert is frozen at the peak of its stock pulse, frame 88.

chargeable_burst.notes: Black Rock reaches burst mode after two penetrations. This stock armed mode shows two charged rounds and the authored folded side indicators. Penetration indicators are hidden in this mode, matching the client. Rotations use the stock close angle asin(6 / 107) * 180 / pi + 2, with stock round x offsets +3/-3 and y offset 107.

concentration.notes: Hacker at start of active concentration (10 s). Shows the original screen-blended widget with the common reverse progress and timer authored on its timeline. The separate original reticle decoration is already handled by the reticle preview.

heating_zones.notes: STK-2 at 100% and outside its stock comfort zone after two 50-point shots. Uses exact configured thresholds .2/.8 and the native .015 separation, stock high-temperature bitmap variants, high-zone highlight, and cursor and markers at the native angular positions.

low_charge_shot.notes: The stock LOW_CHARGE state shows the completed green first-stage timer at lowChargeTime and the red second-stage timer at timeLeft, with the stock long readout position. The mutually exclusive quick-reload timer is hidden. The sample shows settled native colors after the transition.

pillbox_siege.notes: Strv 107-12 deployed in pillbox mode with intact devices. Native main movie switches among normal, warning and critical clips; only the stock normal state is shown.

power_mode.notes: Breaker at start of powered 3 s engine mode; speed threshold 7, mode threshold 18, stock max progress.

propellant_gun.notes: Fauteur max overcharge 100/100, regular threshold 70/100, max multiplier 1.575 on the 400-damage AP shell. Original seven arc textures are clipped and aligned by the stock PropellantGunScaleSector thresholds. Native overcharge cursor and warning timeline are frozen in the active sample.

rechargeable_nitro.notes: BZ-79 reserve ready. The vehicle descriptor distinguishes active 10 s, recharge 45 s and cooldown 5 s. No inactive timer is needed in this snapshot.

shell_calibration.notes: Stock presenter maps a penetration-activated bonus to damageBonus and a nonpenetration-activated bonus to penetrationBonus. This uses the former, consistent with the core cassette flag READY|PENETRATION_BONUS.

shell_params_switcher.notes: Pz.Kpfw. Neu uses charged APCR for angled armor. The same vehicle's basic APCR subtype is straight_armor and modified HEAT uses screen. The timer's native export is ShellParamsSwitcherTimerUI.

sight_pointer.notes: WZ-219 sample of the first active scan stage (1 s) without a detected target. The presenter selects found only when the native scan contains vehicles.

staged_jet_boosters.notes: PTZ-78 reuseCount=8, deploy=5 s, recharge=15 s, active=10 s. Direction arrows exist in active frames, not in the chosen ready frame.

stance_dance_fight.notes: CS-67 Szakal at the start of the 13-second stock fight stance, with 100% active duration still remaining. The native focus nodes, full energy bar, and timer are set alongside the idle turbo panel. Key bindings and mode-specific child layout overrides are not applied.

stance_dance_turbo.notes: Inactive turbo paired with active fight at 24 km/h. Stock speed parameter limits are 55 base, +10 active, +15 passive and 40 charge start. Original dial masks, speed readouts and pointer timelines are frozen at this sample. Mode-specific child layout overrides are not applied.

stationary_reload.notes: AS-XX 40 t stock stationary reload active with intact mechanisms. Its separate timer is only used in the preparation or finishing phase (4.5 s and 3 s), so no timer is set in the active state.

support_weapon.notes: Support gun ready. The stock presenter only updates preparing/active progress when in the corresponding phase. No fictitious fired event or target.

target_designator.notes: Borkenkäfer ready for target designation; no synthetic designation. Stock initial deployment=60 s, cooldown=25 s, marked target duration=10 s spotted or 7 s after losing vision.

temperature_overheat.notes: Ares original preparing timeline and cursor at 50% temperature, with the original default color scale bitmaps and native threshold clipping. The _90mm_Ares_2000 gun cools from 50 to 0 at 10.9 x 0.5 temperature units/s when overheated. The native timer clips the final digit of the two-decimal 9.17 s format.

wheeled_dash.notes: Executor dash ready after its 5 s deployment / 20 s recharge; stock active window 4 s. No running timer or vehicle speed is invented.

reticle_owned.autoreloader_surge: Displays the original AutoreloaderSurgeWidgetUI from autoreloaderSurge.swf for both the mechanic and the CAV vehicle.
reticle_owned.accuracy_stacks: Leopard stock accuracy reticle and AccuracyCrosshairUI already owned by reticle preview. No MechanicWidgetsPanel entry for ACCURACY_STACKS.
reticle_owned.overheat_stacks: Hirschkafer OverheatCrosshairUI already owned by reticle preview. OVERHEAT_STACKS is not the overheat gun widget key.
reticle_owned.battle_fury: T803 FuryCrosshairUI and native reload boost already owned by reticle preview. No additional MechanicWidgetsPanel widget.
reticle_owned.extra_shot: AMX reserve-shell stock state resides in the original cassette.
reticle_owned.twingun: Contriver's original twin markers are native reticle children.
reticle_owned.kr_1: Improved ramming does not add a separate gun widget.
